project.name: 影视娱乐个人主页（治愈版）
project.styleDefinitionBrief: 温暖治愈风 — 奶油色基底搭配焦糖棕与鼠尾草绿点缀，如午后阳光洒入的舒适书屋。Noto Serif SC 中文衬线标题传递温暖质感，Inter 正文保持清晰可读。圆润边角、柔和阴影，整体柔软亲切但不失品质。
project.designRead: personal entertainment portal / cinephile & tech enthusiasts / warm healing comfort / medium density / avoid cold blue neon and harsh contrast

colorSystem.primaryColorRole: Caramel accent (#C8956C) for highlights; sage green (#7BAE7F) as semantic secondary for success/progress
colorSystem.brandHuePolicy: Warm caramel primary + sage green secondary; no other brand hues

styleContinuityAnchors.shapeSystem: Softer radius: sm=6px, md=10px, lg=16px, full=9999px. Max 16px for a rounded, approachable feel.
styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: Display: Noto Serif SC (serif) for headings; Body: Inter for text. Chinese-first font stack.
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: Soft shadow-led surfaces on cream; warm brown-tinted shadows, alpha <= 0.05.
styleContinuityAnchors.interactionTone: Gentle 250ms transitions. Cards lift subtly with warm shadow growth.

pages.title: 首页
pages.visualNorthStar: A cozy afternoon in a sunlit reading nook — cream walls, warm wood accents, soft golden light. Like flipping through a beloved film magazine with a cup of tea.
pages.compositionPattern: Warm Hero (centered, rounded card on cream) + Featured Grid + Alternating Content

pages.title: 影视推荐
pages.visualNorthStar: A warm wooden shelf of beloved films — each card like a well-loved DVD case, soft cream backgrounds, rounded edges, caramel highlights on hover.
pages.compositionPattern: Filter Bar + Poster Grid + Editor Pick

pages.title: 学习资料
pages.visualNorthStar: A warm study corner — organized notebooks, sage green progress markers, cream card surfaces. Inviting and calm.
pages.compositionPattern: Category Tabs + Resource Grid with Sidebar

pages.title: AI 分享
pages.visualNorthStar: A warm tech garden — soft cream interface with caramel and sage accents, technology that feels approachable and human.
pages.compositionPattern: Hero + Tool Cards + Article List + CTA
